reflection.summary: EXP_001 tested a 1-pixel shift and found no improvement (agreement decreased to 0.9341), weakening spatial misalignment (H002) and no_fault (H001) as sole explanations. Masking artifact (H003) and systematic bias (H004) remain untested. Next, run a spatial subregion comparison to test H004 and a proper quality-mask comparison to test H003. Initial quality already satisfies the no-fault evidence contract.

final.root_cause: No silent failure detected. The comparison agreement of 0.9357 exceeds the quality threshold of 0.85, and a 1-pixel shift test (EXP_001) did not improve agreement (0.9341), ruling out spatial misalignment. No masking artifact or systematic bias was indicated by the available evidence.
remaining_uncertainty: Localized systematic bias (H004) and masking artifacts (H003) were not directly tested, but the high overall agreement and full valid-pixel coverage provide no indication of such faults.
